visual_action: Donald Trump is shown from the chest up, sitting at a desk in a formal room. He is wearing a dark suit and a gold tie. He briefly looks down at a document before looking up and speaking directly ahead. Several other people in suits stand in the background behind him.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is the only person speaking and the central focus of the video clip.

cast.name: the media
cast.evidence: Trump says, "Most of the media will get that."

on_screen_text.text: ACTUALLY A LEGAL DEFINITION, WHOLE MILK. AND IT'S WHOLE WITH A W FOR THOSE OF YOU THAT HAVE A PROBLEM. MOST OF THE MEDIA WILL PICK UP THAT.

spoken_summary: Donald Trump states that 'whole milk' is a legal definition. He then condescendingly clarifies the spelling of 'whole,' saying, "and it's whole with a W, for those of you that have a problem. Most of the media will get that."
audio_music: The audio consists solely of Donald Trump's spoken words, with no background music or sound effects.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, static shot. The only editing is the addition of an overlay at the top and sequential, animated captions at the bottom that appear as Trump speaks.
central_claim: The video portrays Donald Trump as saying bizarre and condescending things by isolating a clip where he explains how to spell the word 'whole'.
intended_effect: To encourage the viewer to mock Donald Trump and perceive him as foolish or strange.
